23namespace superdex {
24/** @brief Time integration methods. */
25enum struct IntegrationMethod {
26 /**
27 * @brief Backward Euler: 1 step, 1 stage, 1st order, L-stable. Also known as BDF1 and DIRK11.
28 */
29 BackwardEuler,
30
31 /** @brief BDF2: 2 steps, 1 stage, 2nd order, A-stable. */
32 BDF2,
33
34 /** @brief BDF3: 3 steps, 1 stage, 3rd order. */
35 BDF3,
36
37 /** @brief DIRK(2,2): 1 step, 2 stages, 2nd order, L-stable. */
38 DIRK22,
39
40 /**
41 * @brief [Experimental] DIRK(2,3): 1 step, 2 stages, 3rd order.
42 *
43 * @warning This is an experimental feature. It may be changed or removed in the future. Use at
44 * your own risk.
45 *
46 * @note Its step does not end at its last stage, so its steps use velocity-regularized friction
47 * for all contacts (see @ref ContactParams::preferElastoPlasticFriction). Queries refreshed
48 * without a step approximate it with one BackwardEuler stage, which may use elasto-plastic
49 * friction.
50 */
51 DIRK23,
52
53 /** @brief DIRK(3,3): 1 step, 3 stages, 3rd order, L-stable. */
54 DIRK33,
55
56 /**
57 * @brief [Experimental] Symplectic DIRK(1,2): 1 step, 1 stage, 2nd order, A-stable. Also known as
58 * Gauss and implicit midpoint.
59 *
60 * @warning This is an experimental feature. It may be changed or removed in the future. Use at
61 * your own risk.
62 *
63 * @note Its step does not end at its last stage, so its steps use velocity-regularized friction
64 * for all contacts (see @ref ContactParams::preferElastoPlasticFriction). Queries refreshed
65 * without a step approximate it with one BackwardEuler stage, which may use elasto-plastic
66 * friction.
67 */
68 SymplecticDIRK12,
69
70 /**
71 * @brief [Experimental] Symplectic DIRK(2,2): 1 step, 2 stages, 2nd order, A-stable.
72 *
73 * @warning This is an experimental feature. It may be changed or removed in the future. Use at
74 * your own risk.
75 *
76 * @note Its step does not end at its last stage, so its steps use velocity-regularized friction
77 * for all contacts (see @ref ContactParams::preferElastoPlasticFriction). Queries refreshed
78 * without a step approximate it with one BackwardEuler stage, which may use elasto-plastic
79 * friction.
80 */
81 SymplecticDIRK22,
82
83 /** @brief Number of time integration method enum values. */
84 Count,
85
86 /** @brief Default time integration method. */
87 Default = BackwardEuler,
88};
89} // namespace superdex
